# species

butyric - Clostridium_perfringens.t__SGB6191

```{r}
data_transformed <- read.delim("ALL_VAR_SPECIES_MAASLIN_SCFA/features/data_transformed.tsv")

dat1 <- data_transformed[  , "Clostridium_perfringens.t__SGB6191", F]
```

```{r}
models_linear <- readRDS("ALL_VAR_SPECIES_MAASLIN_SCFA/fits/models_linear.rds")

ok <- models_linear$`Clostridium_perfringens.t__SGB6191`$model

library(ggplot2)

ggplot(data = ok,
       mapping = aes(x = butyrate,
                     y = expr)) +
  
  geom_point(mapping = aes(x = butyrate,
                     y = expr,
                     col = termness),
             size = 3) +
  
  geom_smooth(method = "lm") +
  
  labs(x = "butyric",
       y = "Clostridium_perfringens.t__SGB6191") +
  
  theme_bw()
  
```
